# sysd — Distributed Systems Workbench

> Local-first distributed systems architecture workbench combining Excalidraw topology parsing, 11 Staff-level reference blueprints, Free-Flow practice, Cactus Needle 3 + Whistle WASM, and Kokoro neural TTS.
